text.body: mahākaviśrīśaṃbhuviracito baddhaspardhaḥ kṣitidharasutābhrūlatāvakratāyaṃ bhūyādbhūtyai tava haraśiraḥśekharo rohiṇīśaḥ | yaṃ niṣpīḍya stanamukhanakhollekharekhāsu devyāḥ saṃbhogante vitarati sudhāsyandamardhendumauliḥ || 1 || avyātsa vastāṇḍavavibhrameṇa maulau vilīnā hariṇāṇgkalekhā | sā yasya vāme kucamaṇḍalāgre karpūrapatrāṅkurataṅkameti || 2 || premāṇaṃ vinimīlya mallikalikākarṇāvataṃse rasaṃ muktvā mauktikakuṇḍale kuruta bhoḥ śaṃbhorgiraḥ kaṇayoḥ | yuṣmākaṃ ratikāntakārmukalatākreṃkārakānte rute sotkaṇṭhaṃ kalakaṇṭhakaṇṭhakuharoddhūte'pi mā bhūnmanaḥ || 3 || vyāptavyomalate mṛgāṅkadhavale nirdhautadiṅmaṇḍale deva tvadyaśasi praśāntatamasi prauḍhe jagatpreyasi | kailāsanti mahībhṛtaḥ phaṇabhṛtaḥ śeṣanti pāthodhayaḥ kṣīrodanti suradvipanti kariṇo haṃsanti puṃskokilāḥ || 4 || kailāsācalasānusīmani marutsīmantinībhistathā gītāste kalakaṇṭhakaṇṭhaninadaśravyaiḥ svaraiḥ kīrtayaḥ | apyuttaṃsavilāsavānapi rate ratnapradīpo yathā cūḍācandrakalāṅkuraḥ purajitā sadyaḥ prasādīkṛtaḥ || 5 || cauḍīcūḍābharaṇaharaṇaḥ kīrṇakarṇāvataṃsaḥ karṇāṭīnāṃ muṣitamuralīkeralīhāralīlaḥ | kurvannurvītilaka tilakotsṛṣṭalāṭīlalāṭaṃ jīyādekastava navayaśaḥsvarnaśāṇaḥ kṛpāṇaḥ || 6 || śāntyai darpavatāṃ jayāya jagatāṃ saṃpattaye yācatāṃ saṃmānāya satāṃ hitāya mahatāṃ tāpāya pṛthvībhṛtām | sollāsena sakautukena śamitadhyānena dūrīkṛtasvādhyāyena samāptasarvatapasā tvaṃ vedhasā nirmitaḥ || 7 || kiṃ vānyadvasudhāpuraṃdara purastvatpauruṣasya kvacinnārhatyaskhalitakramo'pi gagane traivikramo vikramaḥ || 8 || devākarṇaya nākināṃ puri nṛṇāṃ loke pure bhogināmāsankecana santi kecana tathā sthāsyanti ye kecana | tanmadhye na babhūva nāsti bhavitā tādṛṅna nītau natau kāntau kāvyaratau matau ripuhatau kīrtau ca yaste samaḥ || 9 || ānanda mucukundakandali bhaja svasthāsi vāsantike kalyāṇaṃ tava mallike kuśalinī jātāsi he mālati | adyaitadyaśasi śrutipraṇayitāṃ yāte na kurvanti vaḥ karṇottaṃsarasānnavīnakalikābhaṅgaṃ kuraṅgīdṛśaḥ || 10 || caitraṃ mā smara vismara smara ratiṃ kiṃ sāyakairmārakairgodhāṃ mugdha mudhā badhāna jahihi jyābandhadhīraṃ dhanuḥ | deve'sminhi sakṛtsmṛte'pi na matirnaiva smṛtirna sthitirnāsaktirna dhṛtirna nirvṛtirapi kvāpyāste vāmabhruvām || 11 || jahāti nagarī galatkanakakaṅkaṇaha kauṅkaṇo vanaṃ viśati vihvalaḥ skhalitakuntalaḥ kauntalaḥ | kimanyaduditakrudhi tvayi mṛgendrabhīmāravaṃ taṭaṃ viśati māravaṃ cyutaramālavo mālavaḥ || 12 || tāṃ saṃkrandanamandire suravadhūkarṇāmṛtasyandinīṃ tvatsaundraryakathāṃ niśamya gaditāmānandibhirvandibhiḥ | cāpaṃ muñcati bāṇamujjhati śucaṃ dhatte ratiṃ nekṣate citraṃ caitramupekṣate pariṇamanmandavyatho manmathaḥ || 13 || kīrīhāralatāsu keralavadhūdhammillamālāsu yā colīdantacatuṣkikāsu muralīlīlāsmiteṣu dyutiḥ | agre tvadyaśasāṃ sudhākarakaranyakkārapāraṃgamāmapyetāmasitāmaho sukavayo vindanti nindanti ca || 14 || viṣameṣuvigalitarasāścapalataraṃgālibhirjaḍaiḥ kṣubhitāḥ | timiracitavasatayastava ripusudṛśo nimnagā jātāḥ || 15 || aṅke keralasundarīkacabharaśyāmaṃ kalaṅkaṃ vahanmithyārohati pūrvaparvataśikhāṃ mugdhastamībāndhavaḥ | yattāpicchatarucchadacchavi tamo lumpanti limpanti ca prāleyairiva pāradairiva jagatkośaṃ bhavatkīrtayaḥ || 16 || tasthau kampataraṅgitastanataṭaṃ bāṣpāmbudhautādharaṃ śokākrāntakapolakīlitakaraṃ dyāṃ muñjarāje gate | saṃjāte tvayi hārihāravalayakvāṇaṃ kvaṇatkaṅkaṇaṃ cañcatkāñcanakāñci sā bhagavatī narnarti vāgdevatā || 17 || ālekhyaṃ ciramullilekha vijane sollekhayā rekhayā saṃkalpānakarodvikalpabahulākalpānanalpānapi | adrākṣīdaparaprajāpatimataṃ cakre ca tīvravrataṃ tvannirmāṇavidhau kiyanna vidadhe baddhāvadhāno vidhiḥ || 18 || śeṣa kleśamaśeṣamutsṛja bhaja tvaṃ kūrma karma svakaṃ svairaṃ khelata sindhusaikatālatākuñjeṣu dikkuñjarāḥ | apyetāṃ sakulācalāṃ sanagarāṃ sāmbhonidhiṃ sāpagāṃ sadvīpāṃ ca bhuvaṃ bibharti hi bhujaḥ śrīharṣapṛthvībhujaḥ || 19 || heramba tyaja karṇatālaninadaṃ cūḍāpage garja mā mā mā kāñcanakiṅkiṇīkalakalaṃ kaṇṭhe kakudmankṛthāḥ | prakrāntāsu suraiḥ puraḥ purariporyuṣmadyaśogītiṣu vyagrasyeti parisphuranti vacanānyānandino nandinaḥ || 20 || akaṅkaṇamamekhalāguṇamahāramastāṅgadaṃ vrajanti caturaiḥ padairmarumarātivāmabhruvaḥ | karotyasilatāṃ kare yadasigarvamurvībhujo bhujasya paripanthināmayamadakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe || 21 || rākākāntakalāṅkuraṃ kuru ciraṃ caṇḍīśa cūḍāntare kacchaṃ gaccha purāṇakacchapa paraṃ gambhīramambhonidheḥ | dhyānaṃ muñca virañca kiṃ ca payasā siñcāsanāmbhoruhaṃ yenāyaṃ paritaḥ prabho prasarati prauḍhaḥ pratāpānalaḥ || 22 || kandarpe nalakūbare kumudinīkānte'pyavajñāyatāṃ tvatsaundaryakathāsu tāsu marutāṃ vṛtttāsu kautūhalāt | prāptā tānavamurvaśī ratiratiklāntā hatā rohiṇī jātā kiṃ ca svarasmarajvarabharārambhāpi rambhātanuḥ || 23 || sollāsā api sodyamā api ghanotkaṇṭhā api kvāpi no yānti śyāmaniśāntare'pi ramaṇopāntaṃ kuraṅgīdṛśaḥ | sadyastvadyaśasā hi kuñjararadacchedacchavicchādinā nītaṃ kāntapuraṃdhrikuntalabharaśyāmaṃ virāmaṃ tamaḥ || 24 || na kvāpyaurvajvanalamahasā yasya cakkātha pāthaḥ śoṣaṃ tasminbhajati jaladhau tvatpratāpānalena | śaṅke paṅke patati yatate bālaśevālamūle kūle lolaḥ kimapi kurute kama vaikuṇṭhakūrmaḥ || 25 || ullekhaṃ nijamīkṣate bhaṇitiṣu prauḍhiṃ parāṃ śikṣate saṃdhatte padasaṃpadaḥ paricayaṃ dhatte dhvaneradhvani | vaicitryaṃ vitanoti vācakavidhau vācaspaterantike deva tvadguṇavarṇanāya kurute kiṃ kiṃ na vāgdevatā || 26 || śāntadhvāntakalaṅka śaṃkaraśikhālaṃkāra tārāpate rākākānta savibhramaṃ bhrama sadā niḥśaṅkamaṅke divaḥ | adyaitadyaśasaiva saptasu kṛtālokeṣu lokeṣu hi svarbhānorbhavitāsi nāsi nabhasi cchinnākṛtergocaraḥ || 27 || tvayyutpanne guṇavati satāṃ nābhirāmaḥ sa rāmastyāgavyagre bhavati bhavati mlānavarṇaḥ sa karṇaḥ | brūmaḥ kiṃ vā bahu nanu dhanurvedavidyāvidaste saṅgrāmorvīpurahara puraḥ syādapārthaḥ sa pārthaḥ || 28 || kāntiṃ kalpaya tāntimalpaya sakhi svalpāpi naivāsti te muktāśuktiṣu vārirāśiramaṇi śrītāmraparṇi kṣatiḥ | asyālokya kuraṅgaketanakalālāvaṇyacauraṃ yaśo vartante hi vimuktamauktikalatotkaṇṭhāḥ kuraṅgīdṛśaḥ || 29 || nidrā na draviṇādhipasya bhajate śaṅkāṃ sa laṅkāpatirvyomni vyākulatāmalaṃ kamalinīkāntasya dhatte vapuḥ | kiṃ vānyattava deva vellati yadi bhrūvallarīpallavaḥ so'pi kṣāmakapolakīlitakaraḥ saṃkrandanaḥ krandati || 30 || astaṃ yāti yayātidhāma vigataṃ duṣyantavārtāśataiḥ śāntaṃ śāntanukīrtibhirlaghu raghorlokeṣu jātaṃ yaśaḥ | kiṃ cānyattvayi medinīkumudinī rākāśaśāṅkodaye jāte hanta tathā kathā api vibho rāme virāmaṃ gatāḥ || 31 || lolanmauktikavalli velladalakaṃ vācālakāñcīguṇaṃ cañcatkāncanakaṅkaṇaṃ ca girijā jātotsavā nṛtyatu | tvatkīrtiśravaṇonmukhena vilasatkallolakolāhalā yanmuktā mukuṭānmṛgāṅkaśakalottaṃsena mandākinī || 32 || karpūrairiva pāradairiva sudhāsyandairivāplāvite jāte hanta divāpi deva kakubhāṃ garbhe bhavatkīrtibhiḥ | dhṛtvāṅge kavacaṃ nibadhya śaradhiṃ kṛtvā puro mādhavaṃ kāmaḥ kairavabāndhavodayadhiyā dhunvandhanurdhāvati || 33 || adhikaṃsamāptasamaraḥ prathito bhuvaneṣu gopanarasotkaḥ | bhāti sadānavavijayaṃ kurvankṛṣṇastavāyamasiḥ || 34 || rākākāntakalāṅkurāṅkitajaratkīśo niśīthakṣaṇe gāyantīṣu surāṅganāsu bhavataḥ kailāsakuñje yaśaḥ | niṣpīḍya priyamaulicandrakalikāṃ kandarpakeliklamasvāpaṃ dūrayituṃ dṛśorgirijayā dattāḥ sudhābindavaḥ || 35 || kiṃ tāntiḥ kimanirvṛtiḥ kimadhṛtirvāgdevi muñje gate kiṃ śūnyāsi kimākulāsi kimiti klāntāsi ko'yaṃ kramaḥ | etaṃ viddhi tameva sāsya hi matiḥ sā viśrutiḥ sā dyutiḥ sa tyāgaḥ sa nayaḥ sa sūktiṣu rasastāḥ saṃmatāḥ saṃpadaḥ || 36 || kasmādamba vilambase kuru kṛpāṃ kenāpi rūpeṇa me jihvāgre vasa saṃnidhehi hṛdaye vāgdevi tubhyaṃ namaḥ | yanme sāhasikasya bhūpacaritavyāvarṇane sādaraṃ sapremaprasaraṃ sakautukarasaṃ sollāsamāste manaḥ || 37 || nāke mugdhamadhuvratapraṇayinīhaṃkārahārisvanaiścāru tvaccaritaṃ yadaiva caturairuccāritaṃ cāraṇaiḥ | kāntaṃ mauktikadāmanaddhacikurasvaḥsundarīṇāṃ puraḥ prāpto deva tadaiva sūtritaśarāsāraḥ sasāraḥ smaraḥ || 38 || śrīkhaṇḍadravanirjharanti hṛdaye pīyūṣakallolinīniḥṣyandanti tanau rasāyanarasasyandanti karṇāntike | nāsīraprasaranti dikparisare bhūmaṇḍale mauktikaprastāranti sudhākaranti gaganotsaṅge bhavatkīrtayaḥ || 39 || kiṃ bālena mṛṇālatantumalinacchāyena khaṇḍendunā niḥśaṅko'dya vṛṣāṅka śekharapade rākāśaśāṅkaṃ kuru | devasyāsya hi ketakodaradalacchāyairyaśobhirniśi vyomnaḥ sīmni ca maṇḍale ca kakubhāṃ vyastaṃ samastaṃ tamaḥ || 40 || no caitraḥ sahakārakuḍmalakulaiḥ klṝptaṃ na tatkārmukaṃ nāmī krūraśilīmukhāḥ śitamukhā no kokilāpañcamaḥ | naivoddāmakaraḥ śaśī na makaraḥ ketusthito no ratistatrāpi tvamaho samastaramaṇīmānavyadho manmathaḥ || 41 || tanmūrtaṃ bhuvane muhūrtamamṛtaṃ manye bhṛśaṃ vāsaraṃ sāraṃ vedmi tadeva saiva ca guṇairāyāminī yāminī | śrīvāso yaśasāṃ padaṃ sumanasāmapyāspadaṃ saṃpadāṃ yatrāgacchati gocaraṃ nayanayoḥ kāśmīramīnadhvajaḥ || 42 || saṃjāte jaladātyaye'pi phaṇabhṛtparyaṅkaśayyātalaṃ mā mā muñca mukunda kānakamalādoḥkantalāliṅgitaḥ | jāgarti sthitaye satāṃ virataye yenāsatāmapyayaṃ saṃnaddho guṇimaulimaṇḍanamaṇirbhūmaṇḍalākhaṇḍalaḥ || 43 || ślāghā rāghā lāghavaṃ tava gatā duṣyanta viśvaṃ tava mlāniṃ yāti yaśo gatā tava tathā pārtha prathāpārthatām | jāte'sminguṇibāndhave narapatiśyāmādhave kṣmādhave kasyāpyatra na karṇa karṇapadavīṃ yātā bhavatkīrtayaḥ || 44 || jñātā bhūriyamamburāśirasanā kiṃ nāma nālocitaṃ tatrākhaṇḍalamaṇḍale maṇipure vārtāpi vṛttaiva naḥ | kāntau kīrtiratau naye paricaye kāvyakramaprakrame yāvatkvāpi kadāpi ko'pi bhavataḥ spardhāparo nāparaḥ || 45 || evaṃ tvāmahamarthaye viramitasvādhyāyakautūhalo brahmāṇḍodaramambujāsana punaryatnena vistāraya | devasyāsya yato na māti vitataṃ rākendurocirlatālīlonmīlitakairavodaradaladdhautāvadātaṃ yaśaḥ || 46 || urvī maurvīkiṇabhṛti bhavaddoṣṇi bibhratyaśeṣāṃ śāntaklāntiḥ kimapi kurute narmaṇā karma kūrmaḥ | kṛtvā velāpulinalavalīpallavagrāsagoṣṭhīṃ diṅmātaṅgāḥ samamatha sarinnāthapāthaḥ pibanti || 47 || kiṃ maunaṃ nanu menake kimu śucaṃ dhatse śavi kṣāmatā keyaṃ vāci dhṛtāci sāci kimidaṃ rambhe mukhāmbhoruham | yāte tvaccaraṇāmṛte śrutipathaṃ gīrvāṇavāmabhruvāmevaṃ deva kharasmarajvarajuṣāmuktāḥ sakhībhirgiraḥ || 48 || kiṃ rākendukaracchaṭābhiruditaṃ kiṃ mauktikairudgataṃ kiṃ mallīmukulaiḥ smitaṃ vikasitaṃ kiṃ mālatīkuḍmalaiḥ | kiṃ rūḍhaṃ ramaṇīvilāsahasitaiḥ kiṃ tatra kīrṇaṃ sudhāsyandairyatra jagattrayaikatilaka bhrāntaṃ bhavatkīrtibhiḥ || 49 || noddāmāni diśāṃ mukhāni na ghanābhogā nabhomaṇḍalī naivottālatalaṃ rasātalamiyaṃ pṛthvī na pṛthvī punaḥ | evaṃ deva kathaṃ nu kuñjararadacchedāvadātāstava svairaṃ yānti ca mānti ca śrutisudhādhārāmucaḥ kīrtayaḥ || 50 || yo vairiṣvanilo nalo vasumatīdīpo dilīpo'tha yo yo mānena pṛthuḥ pṛthurjagati yo nirlāghavo rāghavaḥ | yaḥ kīrtau bharato rato nṛpaguṇairyaḥ śaṃtanuḥ śaṃtanuḥ saṃjāte tvayi kasya na kṣitipate sarve'pi te vismṛtāḥ || 51 || apārapulinasthalībhuvi himālaye mālaye nikāmavikaṭonnate duradhirohaṇe rohaṇe | majatyamarabhūdhare gahanakandare mandare bhramanti na patantyaho pariṇatā bhavatkīrtayaḥ || 52 || tātparyaṃ kamalāsane viracitaṃ gaurīhitaiḥ pālitā trailokyādbhutakṛtsnadānavajaye dorvikramo darśitaḥ | ekenaiva kṛtaṃ tu deva bhavatā tatrāpi te na smayo yadvedhāśca purāntakaśca kamalākāntaśca devo'karot || 53 || audāryaṃ sadhane nayo guṇijane lajjā kulastrījane satkāvyaṃ vadane mado dviradane puṃskokilaḥ kānane | rolambaḥ kamale nakhāṅkaracanā kāntākapolasthale tanvī talpatale bhavānapi vibho bhūmaṇḍale maṇḍanam || 54 || jātā tāmarasodare bhagavato dhātuḥ kṛtārthā sthitiryuktaṃ yadyacirātkaroti jaladhau saṃsthāṃ ramāvallabhaḥ | sarvatraiva vibho tava prasarati prauḍhe pratāpānale dhatte so'pi pinākinaḥ saphalatāṃ maulīndurekhāṅkuraḥ || 55 || kaṇṭhāntaḥkvaṇitaṃ divākarakaraklāntyā rajoviplavaistannetrāñcalakuñcanaṃ śitakuśaprāntakṣataiḥ sītkṛtiḥ | śvāsormiprabhavo vanecarabhiyā tvadvairivāmabhruvāmevaṃ deva marostaṭe'pi suratakrīḍānurūpaḥ kramaḥ || 56 || saṃdiṣṭaṃ vasudhāsudhākara śacīkāntena muñcodyamaṃ deva tvaṃ prabalapratāpadahanodrekāya baddhāñjaliḥ | ete mānubhavantu nākataruṇīkarṇāvataṃsocitāḥ klāntiṃ nandanakandalīṣu kalitavyāpallavāḥ pallavāḥ || 57 || śaktiṃ mānasatīvratāpadahane dhatte galatsaṃyamā kāmāśāṃ prakaṭīkaroti na satāṃ sarvatrapāpāsanāt | prema prauḍhamanārataṃ vitanute vṛddheti śuddheti ca prakhyātāpi mahīmanobhava bhavatkīrtirvicitrāḥ striyaḥ || 58 || rūpaṃ yanmadane dyutiḥ śaśini yā gambhīratā yāmbudhau yo merau garimāsti yā kamalinīkānte pratāponnatiḥ | yo lakṣmīramaṇe'pi vikramaguṇastatsarvamekatra ceddraṣṭuṃ vāñchasi dṛśyatāmayamaye devastrilokīmaṇiḥ || 59 || sa khyāto jagati trivikrama iti tvadvikramā bhūrayastenaiko nihato balirbaliśatadhvaṃsī bhuhastāvakaḥ | taṃ vaikuṇṭhavamavaiti ko na jagatīṃ jetuṃ tvakuṇṭho bhavānastyevaṃ mahadantaraṃ tava tathā devasya daityadruhaḥ || 60 || cakre yatra madorjitārjunabhujastambhāhatiṃ bhārgavo yatrāsīddaśakaṇṭhakaṇṭhavipinacchedī raghūṇāṃ patiḥ | pārthenāpi jitaḥ sa yatra girijākāntaḥ kirātākṛtirgītaḥ pallavitādbhutaistava na kaistatrāpi dorvikramaḥ || 61 || rākendorudayabhrameṇa mukhato muktvā mṛṇālāṅkuraṃ tāntiṃ tatra vahanti hanta vilasadbhṛṅgā rathāṅgāṅganāḥ | kiṃ codañcitacañcurañcati śaraccandraprabhābhrāntito harṣaṃ hanta cakorapaṅktiramalaṃ yatroditaṃ te yaśaḥ || 62 || prāleyaiḥ snapayanti kalpalatikāḥ sekānanekānatha śrīkhaṇḍāmbugalajjalairaviralaistanvanti saṃtānake | sāndraiścandramaṇidravairapi vibho mandāravallīmalaṃ siñcantyadya bhavatpratāpadahanatrāsena nākāṅganāḥ || 63 || yātaṃ rāmavirāmaviklavatayā duṣyantaviśrāntijaḥ saṃtāpo vigato vilīnamakhilaṃ duḥkhaṃ nalābhāvajam | kiṃ cānyattvayi deva bibhrati mahāsāmrājyalakṣmīmimāṃ śāntaḥ śāṃtanavo'pi ko'pi vipulābhogo viyogo bhuvaḥ || 64 || kiṃcitkuḍmalitaikalocanapuṭaṃ kaṇḍūṃ muhurgaṇḍayarjhampākampitakuḍmale kurabake nirvāpya vanyadvipaiḥ | deva smerasarojasaṅgasurabhi svairaṃbhavadvairiṇāṃ pītaṃ prāṅgaṇavāpikāmakariṇīpītāvaśeṣaṃ payaḥ || 65 || kūrme dhairyaṃ śithilaya dhṛtiṃ muñca śeṣasya śeṣāmāśāmāśākariṣu vasudhe devi mā mā dadhīthāḥ | śaktaḥ saptāmbunidhiparikhāmekhalāmapyayaṃ tvāṃ voḍhuṃ maurvīkiṇaparicito bhūpaterasya bāhuḥ || 66 || kāntāreṣu ca kānaneṣu ca sarittīreṣu ca kṣmābhṛtāmutsaṅgeṣu ca pattaneṣu ca saridbhartustaṭānteṣu ca | bhrāntāḥ ketakagarbhapallavarudhaḥ śrāntā iva kṣmāpate kānte nandanakandalīparisare rohanti te kīrtayaḥ || 67 || rākendorudayaḥ kimeṣa kimayaṃ gaurīgururvā giriḥ kṣīrodaḥ kimayaṃ kimeṣa purajillīlāvilāsoragaḥ | kiṃ manthādrirayaṃ sudhājalanidherdhautastaraṅgairiti tvatkīrtau vasudhāpuraṃdara sadā saṃdehino dehinaḥ || 68 || vilokanakathāpi me na nalakūbare na smare kimanyadamṛtadyuterapi na darśanaṃ prārthaye | ayaṃ nayanagocaraṃ vrajati ceddṛśāmutsavaḥ samagraramaṇīmanomadhupamādhavaḥ kṣmādhavaḥ || 69 || kundaḥ kandalitavyathaṃ vicakilaḥ kampākulaṃ ketakaḥ sātaṅkaṃ madanaḥ sadainyamalasaṃ mukto'timuktadrumaḥ | moktuṃ kiṃ tu na pāritastava ripustrībhiḥ purīnirgame tatkālaṃ kṛtamādhavīpariṇayaḥ satkesaraḥ kesaraḥ || 70 || tadyuktaṃ nanu kumbhasambhva bhavatprajñārahasyena yaddyāṃ ca kṣmāṃ ca tirodadhanniravadhirvindhyo'pi vandhyaḥ kṛtaḥ | devsyāsya śaranniśākarakaranyakkārapāraṃgamaṃ mātyetatkathamanyathā pariṇataṃ dyāvāpṛthivyoryaśaḥ || 71 || dhiktaṃ mallīkusumakalitaṃ kelikarṇāvataṃsaṃ dhvaṃsaṃ so'pi vrajatu viphalo ratnatāṭaṅgaṭaṅkaḥ | he rājānaḥ prakṛtisaralaiḥ śāṃbhavaireva sūktairyuktaḥ kartuṃ bhavati bhavatāṃ kevalaṃ karṇapūraḥ || 72 || udbhinnā kalakaṇṭhakaṇṭhakuharātkarṇāmṛtasyandinī yuktā yadyapi mārdavaikavasatiḥ sā kākalīhuṃkṛtiḥ | anyastanvi tathāpi te paśupatipluṣṭasya jrīvārpaṇe pañceṣorucitaḥ prapañcitarasaḥ pākāñcitaḥ pañcamaḥ || 73 || kiṃ hāraiḥ kimu kaṅkaṇaiḥ kimu sumaiḥ kiṃ karṇapūrairalaṃ keyūrairmaṇikuṇḍalairalamalaṃ sāḍambarairambaraiḥ | puṃsāmekakhaṇḍanaṃ punaridaṃ śaṃbhormate maṇḍanaṃ yanniṣpīḍitapārvaṇenduśalakasyandopamāḥ sūktayaḥ || 74 || pīyūṣadravahāriṇī sumanasāṃ bhrūlāsyavistāriṇī tvatsevābhiratāpi kāpyabhinavā vāgdevate bhāratī | astyekā tu kṛtāñjalerjanani me śaṃbhoriyaṃ prārthanā madvācāṃ kvacidastu vastunipuṇaḥ śrotā sacetā janaḥ || 75 || || iti kāśmīradeśodbhavamahākaviśrīśaṃbhuviracito rājendrakarṇapūraḥ samāptaḥ ||
